scripts.check:fonts: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage/fonts', { recursive: true })" && python -m coverage run --data-file=coverage/fonts/.coverage --branch --source=scripts scripts/subset-website-fonts.py --check && python -m coverage xml --data-file=coverage/fonts/.coverage -o coverage/fonts/coverage.xml && python -m coverage report --data-file=coverage/fonts/.coverage --fail-under=80
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:governance
scripts.test:governance: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('coverage/governance', { recursive: true })" && node --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-exclude=**/*.test.mjs --test-coverage-lines=80 --test-coverage-functions=80 --test-coverage-branches=80 --test --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter-destination=coverage/governance/lcov.info scripts/check-pr-size.test.mjs scripts/validate-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/boundaries.test.mjs scripts/validate.test.mjs scripts/check-ci.test.mjs
